summary: WWPT, nicknamed "Wrecker Radio," is a high school radio station broadcasting on 90.3 FM and licensed to serve Westport, Connecticut. The station is owned by Staples High School and licensed to the Westport Board of Education, and it airs a high school radio format. The note is a brief overview with no further detail.
